summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour delivers a lecture on the rulings of the Adhan (call to prayer) and Iqamah (establishment of prayer). He discusses the Sunnah actions that should be performed after hearing the Adhan, including repeating what the Muezzin says, sending blessings upon the Prophet Muhammad, and reciting specific duas. Sh. Ali Mashhour explains the virtue of requesting Al-Wasilah (the highest station in Paradise) for the Prophet and the promise of his intercession on the Day of Judgment for those who do so sincerely. The lecture covers hadith narrations from Sahih Muslim and Sahih Bukhari regarding these practices and their rewards.
suggested_title: The Rulings of Adhan and Iqamah: Duas and Actions After the Call to Prayer
